description: This file defines the React component 'OrderDetailPage' which displays detailed information about a specific order, including tracking, items, payment, and shipping address. It handles fetching order data, updating order status, and reordering items. It also integrates with external services for order and cart management.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Function to re-add items from the order back to the cart, notifying the user of success or skipped items.
